title: US Proposes Economic Incentives to Russia for Limited Truce
summary: The Trump administration has proposed three economic incentives to Moscow – unlocking up to $100 billion in frozen assets, approving a Lukoil portfolio buyout, and easing sanctions on Belarusian potash – to secure a limited energy or maritime ceasefire with Ukraine. While Kyiv demanded reciprocal safeguards and military aid guarantees, Russian President Vladimir Putin reiterated hardline demands following an Oct. 9 call with Donald Trump.

title: A ‘Cold Fish’ Who ‘Never Made Eye Contact’ – Former UK PM on Putin
summary: Speaking at the Henley Literature Festival this week, former UK Prime Minister Theresa May offered insight into her time as leader, describing Russian President Vladimir Putin as a “completely cold fish” who avoided eye contact at G20 meetings. In a special podcast interview, she contrasted US President Donald Trump’s first and second administrations, likening Oval Office diplomacy to a “TV show,” and expressed disappointment over Volodymyr Zelensky’s treatment during his February 2024 White House meeting with Trump.
